scope: Byte-exact rebuild verification of the reviewed SORA Nexus executor and Polkadot crypto npm Wasm packages.

canonical_environment.execution: Linux amd64 container under Rosetta in the existing aarch64 Colima VM

independent_linux_rebuild.command: docker --context colima-sora-release-verify run --rm -i --name sora-reviewed-wasm-independent-check --platform linux/amd64 --mount type=volume,source=sora-reviewed-wasm-linux-parity,target=/cache --mount type=bind,source=/Users/takemiyamakoto/dev/sora2-network,target=/repo,readonly sora-reviewed-wasm-rebuild:2026-10-24 bash -s < /tmp/sora2-chopsticks-native-review/linux-independent-check.sh
independent_linux_rebuild.setup_script_contents:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /cache/repro-source/vendor /cache/repro-source/misc/dependency_security /cache/repro-target
for package in chopsticks-executor polkadot-wasm-crypto polkadot-wasm-crypto-wasm sora-secp256k1-compat; do
  cp -a "/repo/vendor/$package" /cache/repro-source/vendor/
done
cp /repo/rust-toolchain.toml /cache/repro-source/
cp /repo/misc/dependency_security/{Dockerfile.wasm-rebuild,rebuild_wasm_in_container.sh} /cache/repro-source/misc/dependency_security/
if [ ! -d /cache/repro-cargo ]; then cp -al /cache/cargo /cache/repro-cargo; fi
export CARGO_HOME=/cache/repro-cargo
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/cache/repro-target
cd /cache/repro-source
node vendor/chopsticks-executor/scripts/build-reviewed.mjs --check --build-tools-dir /opt/build-tools
node vendor/polkadot-wasm-crypto/scripts/build-reviewed.mjs --check --build-tools-dir /opt/build-tools
python3 vendor/chopsticks-executor/scripts/verify-artifacts.py
python3 vendor/polkadot-wasm-crypto/scripts/verify-artifacts.py
